acceptanceCriteria: RESULT.schema.json (stable and repository-envelope copies) accepts opaque/0 and corvint-test-runner-receipt/0; the sealed chain is re-bound through a recorded regeneration path; a verify result for an unadmitted fixture map validates against the schema.
body: Codex P2 finding on PR beamfall/corvint#1338 (V1-2096, CEM-V1-310..313): stable and sealed repository-envelope RESULT.schema.json copies require references.runnerReceipts[].profile = corvint-test-runner-receipt/0, so the verify result for a new unadmitted map (opaque/0) fails that schema although the verdict is ACCEPT. Fixing needs re-binding the sealed CEM-V1-091 chain; cem-stable-regen has no enum-widening mode.
title: RESULT.schema.json still requires the old runner receipt label for unadmitted maps
